description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnService operation to query the status of the DCDN service. The status includes the current billing method, the service activation time, the next billing method that will take effect, and the current service status
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnService查询DCDN服务状态。包括：当前计费类型、服务开通时间、下次生效的计费类型、当前业务状态等
name: DescribeDcdnService
